description: Output-style eval: the ndv-honest output style vs the same model with no style. Every check is a regex on the reply (case-insensitive, Markdown bold/italic markers stripped first). `within` limits the match to the first N characters, `absent: true` inverts it. Checks score fidelity to agents/ndv-honest.md, not a preferred answer. `info: true` checks (long-form fact coverage) are reported but not part of the verdict: the agent may legitimately answer a padded-length request with one blunt sentence and a concise answer. `conflictOneSentence` passes when the reply names no conflict, or names it in a single sentence.

universal.name: no filler
universal.pattern: great question|i understand|that's (an )?interesting|happy to help|hope (this|that) helps|let me know if|feel free to|i'd be glad|certainly!|absolutely!
